additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists medicinalproductdefinition as an active resource and maps legacy MedicinalProduct to MedicinalProductDefinition, with aliases from the old name children to the current part/usage children. The active StructureDefinition defines MedicinalProductDefinition.name.type as a 0..1 CodeableConcept bound to medicinal-product-name-type. Community searches found no relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The authoritative current source already satisfies the issue by providing a name-level type in the active successor resource, so adding redundant prose or model changes would risk drift rather than fix a current defect.
